notes: PWS-0407 remains done. PWS-0408 is in review: desktop package review, accessible plain-text summaries, explicit companion saving, and the automated generic end-to-end pilot are implemented and verified. Full integration completed successfully, all 4633 unit tests and 67 accessibility tests passed, and security finished with 572 passed and 6 unavailable Windows link-fixture skips. The unchanged quality metrics were rebound to the evaluated implementation revision, and a synthetic release-test fixture was corrected without weakening the production gate. Genuine first-time-user and keyboard-only human acceptance remains unrecorded, so PWS-0409 stays planned. Human acceptance permits that gate to start; it does not approve a release. Durable package history still requires a versioned schema/migration decision, mixed image/scan transformation with overlays in one output remains unsupported, and no optional technical manifest or sibling interface is introduced. Packaged-build evidence remains TBD.

PWS-0201 current-implementation review adds an evidence-based decoder ADR and native closure, explicit unsupported image color/depth refusals, and an ordinary verified image-to-PDF desktop action. Focused regressions and a real desktop import/reopen/export smoke with staged trusted runtime passed. Exact-head quality CI is the final acceptance record; see docs/evidence/pws0201-current-review.md. Existing PWS-0408/PWS-0409 state and release-interface TBD facts remain unchanged.
This manifest intentionally omits a hash of itself.
